historical_commentary.text: This note addressed a common UX need — letting users sort list columns interactively — using 4D v6's output forms and arrow key events. While the specific implementation is tied to the v6 form object model, the concept of providing an intuitive column-sort GUI is universal. Modern 4D offers list boxes with built-in sortable column headers, making this kind of manual implementation unnecessary.
related_updates: List boxes in later 4D versions provide built-in sortable column headers, eliminating the need for custom sort GUI code
4D's form event and object model have been substantially modernized since v6
